summary: Tested 3 demo enhancements: pre-seeded data, read-only mode, onboarding tour. Fixed 2 bugs (missing guard_demo on POST /api/policies and POST /api/audits). All 22 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified.

fixed.issue: Missing guard_demo() - demo users could create policies
Missing guard_demo() and using wrong model (Audit instead of AuditCreate)

frontend: Login page shows Demo Admin and Demo User buttons
Demo Admin button click redirects to /dashboard
Demo banner shows at top: 'You're viewing the demo. Data is pre-loaded and modifications are disabled.'
Demo banner has 'Create free account' link
Demo Mode badge visible in header
Dashboard shows pre-seeded data: 7 Policies, 32 Mappings, 5 Open Risks, 2 Audits, 6 Tasks, 4 Vendors
Framework compliance chart shows NIST frameworks with bars
Risk distribution pie chart shows Medium (6) and High (1) risks
Tasks page shows 6 pre-seeded tasks with various statuses
Clicking 'New Task' button shows demo mode error toast (not dialog)
Evidence page shows 5 pre-seeded evidence items with type badges
Activity page shows pre-seeded activity log entries
Onboarding tour (Joyride) appears on first demo login

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: POST /api/policies was missing guard_demo() call - demo users could create policies
Fixed: POST /api/audits was using Audit model directly instead of AuditCreate, causing 422 validation errors
seed_data_creation: Demo accounts and data are seeded on backend startup via seed_demo_accounts(). Data includes: 6 policies, 7 risks, 6 tasks, 4 vendors, 5 evidence items, 2 audits, 2 training modules, 32 control mappings, 6 activity log entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 demo enhancements working: (1) Pre-seeded data loads correctly for demo accounts, (2) Read-only mode blocks all write operations with 403 and shows toast on frontend, (3) Onboarding tour appears on first demo login. Two bugs were fixed: POST /api/policies and POST /api/audits were missing guard_demo() calls. Integration toggles on Integrations page are UI-only (state not persisted to backend - by design).

mocked_apis.integration_toggles: Integration toggle state is stored in React state only, not persisted to backend - this is by design as documented

bugs_fixed.fix: Added guard_demo(current_user) at start of create_policy function

bugs_fixed.issue: Using Audit model directly instead of AuditCreate, causing 422 validation errors
bugs_fixed.fix: Created AuditCreate model and updated endpoint to use it with proper guard_demo
